title: Contraction with a constant vector preserves test forms
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let β be an (m+1)-form on ℝ^P which is a test form (IsTestForm β: C^∞ with compact support), and let v ∈ ℝ^P. Then the m-form ι_vβ : z ↦ β(z).curryLeft v is a test form.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (v : Euclid P), IsTestForm β → IsTestForm (fun z => ContinuousAlternatingMap.curryLeft (β z) v)
